title: Navimower 0.4.4-beta38

## Repository privacy and interoperability cleanup

This prerelease is a public-repository cleanup. It does not intentionally change mower runtime behavior from beta37.

### Changed

- Reframe the README and attribution around the user-facing Home Assistant integration and community interoperability instead of documenting protocol provenance or research history.
- Remove retired H5 research helpers and the historical regression tests that existed only for those retired helpers.
- Keep normal Home Assistant Download diagnostics cached-only and sanitized, with the existing word-aware redaction for credentials, account/device identifiers, exact geographic coordinates, anti-theft data and other sensitive values.
- Keep sensitive development captures outside the normal public support workflow; public bug reports should use the sanitized Download diagnostics export.
- Use neutral settings/runtime terminology in active code comments where the older wording described how behavior had originally been discovered rather than what the code currently does.

### Unchanged

- The beta37 completed-zone coverage regression protection remains unchanged.
- Mowing pause reason, scheduler, maps, gates, georeference, MQTT and mower controls are unchanged by this cleanup.
- Existing Navimower brand/logo assets are intentionally unchanged in this prerelease.
